<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/marketing.ts -->
<!--
  Key numbers in a row or grid: plain figures, cards (StatTile) or figures with an icon. Axes: columns (2, 3,
  4), item (plain, card, icon), surface (none, image, panel: one rounded card), align, density, tone. Title may
  be empty.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";

  export type StatsBandProps = {
    id: string;
    title?: string;
    stats: Stat[];
    cols?: "2" | "3" | "4";
    layout?: "row" | "stack";
    surface?: "none" | "image" | "panel";
    item?: "plain" | "card" | "icon";
    align?: "start" | "center";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Backdrop from "../components/backdrop.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import StatFigure from "../components/stat-figure.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title = "",
    stats,
    cols = "4",
    layout = "row",
    surface = "none",
    item = "plain",
    align = "center",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: StatsBandProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  align={align}
  measure={
    (surface as string) === "panel" ? "fill"
    : (layout as string) === "stack" ? "xs"
    : "default"
  }
  class={cn(
    cn((((surface as string) === "image") ? "bg-transparent" : ""), (((surface as string) === "panel") ? "py-0" : "")),
    (
      (((surface as string) === "image") ? "image" : "none") === "image" ? "relative isolate overflow-hidden"
      : ""
    )
  )}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Backdrop kind={(((surface as string) === "image") ? "image" : "none")} alt={title} />
  {#if ((surface as string) === "panel")}
    <Grid
      cols={
        (cols as string) === "2" ? "2"
        : (cols as string) === "3" ? "2-3"
        : (cols as string) === "4" ? "2-4"
        : "3-6"
      }
      class={cn("w-full items-center bg-muted px-6", defaults.stats.panel)}
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each stats as stat (stat.id)}
        <StatFigure stat={stat} item={item} align={align} />
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {:else}
    <Grid
      cols={
        (layout as string) === "stack" ? "1"
        : (cols as string) === "2" ? "2"
        : (cols as string) === "3" ? "2-3"
        : (cols as string) === "4" ? "2-4"
        : "3-6"
      }
      class="gap-6"
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each stats as stat (stat.id)}
        <StatFigure stat={stat} item={item} align={align} />
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
